summary: Alpha Star Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC trading OTC under ALSUF/ALSAF/ALSWF/ALSTF, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval at an October 13, 2026 extraordinary general meeting of amendments to its charter and Investment Management Trust Agreement with Wilmington Trust. The amendments eliminate the monthly trust extension payment beginning October 2026 and permit up to twelve one-month extensions, pushing the business-combination deadline from December 15, 2026 to December 15, 2027, without further trust deposits. No deal terms, target, premium, or advisor were disclosed. Watch for a combination announcement or liquidation risk as the runway extends.
